Standard Human.description: Well-rounded and broadly capable across all disciplines of life.

features.name: Broad Potential
features.tldr: You receive a +1 bonus to all six ability scores.

Variant Human.description: Focused and specialized, gaining early mastery through a specific feat and customized skills.

features.name: Skilled Pioneer
features.tldr: You gain one feat of your choice, proficiency in one skill of your choice, and a +1 bonus to two different ability scores.
